node.statement: Coordinate-preservation and range identification. Since the coordinate read-offs x = (x_Q) and y = (y_Q) are affine functionals of the row-points and P²=P with P·1 = 1, the vectors 1, x, y are right-fixed by P (P·x = x, P·y = y, P·1 = 1); being three linearly independent fixed vectors (D, E independent, actors non-collinear) they span the range of P, so P is exactly the projection onto span{1, x, y}. Consequently every row i satisfies sum_j P_{ij} = 1 with negative mass sum_j max(-P_{ij},0) = nu_i ≤ t, and reproduces its coordinates: x_i = sum_j P_{ij}·x_j and y_i = sum_j P_{ij}·y_j.
node.inference: linear_algebra (affine functionals preserved by an idempotent that fixes 1)
